title: Free LLM API Hub score (/api/v1/score.json)
description: The FLLMAPIHUB score of every eligible provider, with its parts. Contract v1: fields are only added within v1, so consumers must ignore fields they do not know; a field named here is never renamed, removed or retyped in v1.

version.description: The dataset release version (SemVer), the same as in every other file of /api/v1/.

generated.description: The date of the last dataset change. The scores are computed at this date, so the file is byte-stable for a given dataset.

method.description: The public page that explains how the score works.

weights.description: The points each part can add, out of 100 in total.

editorial_default.description: The editorial points a provider gets when it has no rating of its own.

editorial_neutral.description: True while every provider carries the editorial default, so the editorial part moves no position.

min_confirmed.description: How many of the six mathematical inputs must be confirmed for a provider to enter the top.

top_size.description: The most providers the top holds.

count.description: The number of providers listed; equals the length of providers.

providers.description: Every eligible provider (verified and inside the freshness window), best score first; ties break by the mathematical score, then by name.

editorial.description: The editorial points after the cap, one decimal.

confirmed.description: How many of the mathematical inputs the data confirms.

of.description: How many mathematical inputs there are.

parts.description: The points of each mathematical input, one decimal.

in_top.description: True when the provider is in the top (a text-LLM provider that meets the minimum and ranks within top_size).

top_rank.description: The place in the top, or null when the provider is not in it.

tier_near_threshold.description: True when the model-quality tier is near a threshold and could change at the next snapshot; the score keeps it as it is.
